Simultaneous 2 player patch for **R.C. Pro-Am (USA) (Rev 1)** on the NES.

**Download:** `rcproam_2p.ips` (below, under Assets)

Apply it to `R.C. Pro-Am (USA) (Rev 1).nes` (CRC32 `0296E5F4`) with any IPS tool
(Flips, Lunar IPS, or an online patcher). The patched ROM has CRC32 `84EF5DB6`.

The title screen has a **1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYERS** menu: choose with up/down or
SELECT (START on controller 2 picks 2 PLAYERS), then press START. Player 2
drives the green car, and the screen follows whoever is in the lead. See the README for the full rules.

1-player games are unchanged.
